layout_observed: Monaco Grand Prix 3.337km/19-corner street circuit; tunnel below the Fairmont complex.
review_scope: 16 sparse overview frames plus24detail frames330–606seconds viewed. Edited race montage with cuts; timestamps are not lap station fractions.

reviewed_visual_evidence.notes: Pit straight and Sainte-Dévote: Stands and stone/pink apartment tiers frame the uphill opening. Pit/service bars, marina edge, Armco and high mesh fence. Sainte-Dévote needs its opening/runoff access, not a solid urban wall.

Pit straight and Sainte-Dévote: Stands and stone/pink apartment tiers frame the uphill opening. Pit/service bars, marina edge, Armco and high mesh fence. Sainte-Dévote needs its opening/runoff access, not a solid urban wall.

Pit straight and Sainte-Dévote: Stands and stone/pink apartment tiers frame the uphill opening. Pit/service bars, marina edge, Armco and high mesh fence. Sainte-Dévote needs its opening/runoff access, not a solid urban wall.

Beau Rivage, Massenet and Casino: Steep uphill street with continuous inhabited facades, stepped retaining walls, trees and upper hillside apartments. Casino/Hotel de Paris geometry needs targeted review; overview has no reliable close view.

Mirabeau, Fairmont and Portier: Tight descending sequence between pale hotel/apartment walls and planted terraces; palms and close red/white kerbs. Fairmont compound is a broad terraced hotel, not a freestanding tower. Bridge/overhang near hairpin seen, exact assignment needs registration.

Tunnel: Road is below the Fairmont podium and sea-facing gallery. Preserve drivable deck elevation independently from roof heights. Overview does not directly show interior lighting, so tunnel cross-section/portal details need targeted frames.

Nouvelle chicane and harbour edge: Harbour yachts, masts and large moored vessel silhouettes, steep apartment-covered slopes behind. Exposed pale rock cliff/retaining wall on inland side; red/white chicane islands and close Armco.

Tabac and swimming pool: Marina water and yachts opposite close white multi-level balcony facades and apartment terraces. Low harbour structures and grandstands; linked short kerbs with narrow escape corridors.

Rascasse, Antony Noghès and pits: Constricted final turns between harbour hospitality and pit structures; roof/canopy layering, guardrail returns and pedestrian gaps. Final corner feeds directly into confined pit straight.

additional_reviewed_visual_evidence.notes: Casino Square/Hotel de Paris pale ornate facade: repeated arched lower bays, recessed dark glazing, classical pilasters/cornices and palms.
Tunnel interior: low white panel ceiling, rectangular pale tiled walls, repeated fluorescent bars and close Armco.
Tunnel curve visible continuously under white ceiling; wall tile grid and continuous safety rail.
Fairmont hairpin: white layered projecting balcony slabs, recessed dark glazing, palms at apex terrace and tight red/white kerb.
Tunnel exit portal: dark underside and piers giving way to daylight, wall/ad panels at road edge.
